title: 有馬記念の後に・祭だ祭だわあっしょい

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One wins the Arima Kinen. Now, she's reached the top of both regional and central races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As she stands at the heart of the massive festival she's created, Inari One declares that all Umamusume and races, whether they're regionals or centrals, are equally the greatest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Inari One is named Umamusume of the Year. The people of Oi throw her a celebratory festival, marking a boisterous start to the days to come.
